name: Perigee Abyss
core_rationale: Lowest inverted gravity trench of Continent 03 where Vesper's sunken basalt anchors hang directly above the northern ocean maelstrom.
local_conflict: Abyssal gravity-wraiths and deep-tide leviathans prowl the inverted basalt anchor-chains at the bottom of the Shattered Halo.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Crushing inverted tidal shear along the Maelstrom Eye Lip snaps unreinforced tether-lines; Dive-Master Corin requires the Keel Gyro-Compass before opening the northern sea-lip.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Tether-divers say that if you drop a brass coin from Perigee Abyss, it falls upward for three minutes before splashing into Nebula Undertide.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A ring of inverted basalt stalactites hanging just above the roaring spray of the northern ocean whirlpool.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient sea-gate lies submerged directly beneath the Maelstrom Eye Lip of Perigee Abyss?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater at the lowest perigee rim of Continent 03 and links West to Crown Beacon Citadel.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Inverted basalt stalactites and diving-bell stations suspended directly above the roaring spray of the northern ocean maelstrom.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 12.5m basalt anchor-chain boardwalks, 0.58 to 0.60m winch-lock benches, and 0.14m basalt risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 grid connects Stalactite Plunge, Perigee Diving-Station, and Submerged Orrery Keel B1 across [48, 50] with aquatic and spirit families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-maelstrom-eye-lip at [1, 0] as a Mystery frontier behind a fog_of_lore portal on Perigee Diving-Station.
